wiki.title: Roger Hauck
wiki.extract: Roger Hauck (born October 8, 1961) is an American politician who has served in the Michigan Senate from the 34th district since 2023. Roger grew up on a beef and dairy farm and graduated from Beal City High School. He then attended Central Michigan University before starting a 24-year career at the Delfield Company. He also co-owns a small building company.
